title: How Jacky Chou made $231.6k in October: revenue stream breakdown and sprint-based income thinking
summary: Jacky walks through each October revenue source (link building, Amazon affiliate, adult, private community, SEO agency, Levanta and more), what moved the numbers and how durable each is. His core stance: make-money-online niches decay, so earn aggressively in sprints, diversify, and park profits in lower-risk assets.

principles.text: Earn hard in short sprints, then move profits into lower-risk assets, because make-money-online niches don't last.
principles.quote: I don't think the longevity of making money online niches is good hence why you should do it in Sprints so what that means is you trying to make as much money as possible in a short amount of time

principles.text: Selling a differentiated offer nobody else has can turn it into your best seller (local guest posts outsold niche edits).
principles.quote: I think we are still the only ones on the internet doing it

principles.text: Building in public inside a paid community boosts engagement and retention.
principles.quote: why did advice pop off this month it's because I did two things differently one I built the 2K a day uh par parasite SEO site in public in the secret channel

principles.text: Protect revenue with contracts: partners who moved away without paying a share led him to write a partnership contract.
principles.quote: some Partners moved away from us um they refus to pay us a percentage it's okay um yeah hence why I created the partnership contract so we don't get screwed like this anymore

principles.text: Single-platform and traffic-source revenue is fragile; Google crackdowns cut his Amazon affiliate income from ~100k months, so keep multiple streams.
principles.quote: it's not great historically because I think an alltime high I think we've done like 100k months but we've been clapped down heavily

principles.text: Pick affiliate programs by conversion: trusted, high-review Amazon products convert better than sketchy-looking alternatives.
principles.quote: levanta uh converts way better because if you push someone to a 4,000 review uh product on Amazon people would buy that over their like you know fanfi sketchy sites
